title: The Demon Tailor
text: A demon tailor sits cross-legged on a slab in the Pit, needles in his mouth, a bolt of red cloth across his knees. He offers to mend your gear, good as new, better. His thread is made of screams, and you can hear them, very faintly, in his stitches.

options.label: Let him mend your gear with his screaming thread. Good gear is good gear.

outcomes.text: Better than new, and it whispers, very faintly, all the time, and you never get used to it.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles his price down, and pays him in something small.

outcomes.text: A good price, paid in a small lie, which he stitches in with the rest. You can hear it in there sometimes.

options.label: Refuse his needle. You would rather go in rags than wear those screams.

outcomes.text: He is offended, and spits out his pins, and tells his friends, who come to discuss it.
